messages:
frank-support: FYI — customer ACME Systems opened a billing dispute. Invoice INV-2026 was issued and paid yesterday but they were charged NY sales tax (8.875%). Customer says the PO (PO-997) is for their NJ entity and they have a valid NJ resale certificate attached. Screenshot and PDFs in the ticket.
jamie-billing: Can you drop the invoice link and payment txn id? Did card actually clear or is it pending?
frank-support: Invoice: https://redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026
Payment: txn_0xabc123 cleared 2025-12-02 16:12 UTC
Attachments: ACME_NJ_ResaleCert.pdf, PO-997.pdf (linked in ticket)
maria-finance: Thanks. If payment cleared we need to issue a credit note and refund to the card, then reissue a tax-exempt invoice. Per policy we also need the resale cert stored in our tax_cert bucket and the customer's EIN/Tax ID recorded.
frank-support: Customer provided EIN in the PO (EIN: 12-3456789). Asked for refund to the card and reissued invoice ASAP — they're blocked on procurement.
jamie-billing: I'll queue the reversal once finance confirms. Also want to understand why tax was applied. Our tax logic should use the invoice.bill_to entity when PO present; if it used the card billing address (NY) that's a bug.
jon-eng: Looking at the billing service: current lookup is effectively tax_region = invoice.bill_to.state || card.billing_address.state. There's an edge-case where when a PO is attached we weren't populating invoice.bill_to in the generated invoice JSON, so it fell back to the card address. I can push a targeted fix to prefer po_entity when PO exists and add a unit/integration test. For this thread I can do a manual override on INV-2026.
frank-support: Customer asked for timeline — they want refund processed today. Can we confirm ETA?
maria-finance: I initiated the credit note. Refund txn id: txn_0xdef456 started. Credit note CN-1245 created referencing INV-2026. Reissued invoice INV-2026-R with tax set to 0.00 and included PO-997 and resale cert reference.
jamie-billing: Great. Can you also confirm we recorded the resale cert to S3 path s3://tax_certs/acme/ACME_NJ_ResaleCert.pdf and linked to vendor record vendor_8543? We need that for audit and to prevent recharging.
maria-finance: Confirmed: file present and linked to vendor_8543. Logged adjustment in accounting system with memo: "Tax reversal due to valid NJ resale certificate; refund issued to card; reissued net invoice." Filed internal ticket FIN-342 to review tax jurisdiction fallback and add checks when PO present.
billing-bot: Rule update applied: prefer po_entity for tax jurisdiction when PO exists. Deployed to staging and prod. (rule id: TAX-FALLBACK-2025)
jon-eng: Deployed a small fix in billing-service to ensure invoice.bill_to is populated when PO is included and added an integration test asserting tax uses invoice.bill_to over card.billing_address. PR #4621 merged.
frank-support: Customer responded: "Received refund and corrected invoice — thanks for the quick turnaround." Closing loop. :relieved:
jamie-billing: Marking as resolved on our side. Will include this case in the weekly billing postmortem and add regression test to the QA plan. :thumbsup:
maria-finance: Closing FIN-342 once we confirm no other recent invoices affected. Leaving notes in the customer record and attaching credit note + reissued invoice PDFs.
frank-support: Thanks team"
